verse.text: I have singled him out so that he will direct his sons and their families to keep the way of the Lord by doing what is right and just. Then I will do for Abraham all that I have promised.

video.title: What Makes a Great Father? | Luke 15:20 | 5-Min Daily Devotional

reflection: God didn't just bless Abraham with a promise — He entrusted him with a job: point your kids toward what's right. That's still the calling today; it's less about having every answer and more about steadily, patiently directing your family toward God's way through the ordinary moments of dinner tables, car rides, and bedtime talks. Your kids are watching which way you walk long before they listen to what you say.
